page_title: VIL 3-0 ALA | Villarreal v Alaves 09/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Alejandro Quintero has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
90+5' Joan Jordan (Alaves) steps up to send the ball in.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' 3 - 0 Goal! Juan Bernat plays a pass to the feet of Santi Comesana (Villarreal), and he shoots into the bottom left corner from inside the box. It's 3:0.
89' Toni Martinez (Alaves) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
85' A substitution has been made. Ayoze Perez is replaced by Juan Bernat (Villarreal).
83' Alejandro Quintero shows a yellow card to Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) for his blatant foul.
81' 2 - 0 Goal! Dani Parejo (Villarreal) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Antonio Sivera into the bottom right corner.
81' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) is going to take the penalty!
81' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Villarreal!

81' Play continues despite the shouts by some Villarreal players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Alejandro Quintero interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
80' That looked a certain handball by Manu Sanchez (Alaves) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
77' The game has come to an end for Carlos Vicente. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Tomas Conechny (Alaves).
76' Luis Garcia Plaza decides to make a substitution. Kike Garcia will be replaced by Toni Martinez (Alaves).
74' The referee signals a corner kick to Alaves.
74' Carlos Martin (Alaves) receives a yellow card.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Santi Comesana (Villarreal) is coming onto the pitch as Pape Gueye cannot continue after picking up an injury.
73' Substitution. Thierno Barry (Villarreal) on for Nicolas Pepe.
68' It's time for a substitution. Stoichkov (Alaves) comes on in place of Jon Guridi.
68' Here is a change. Ander Guevara is going off and Luis Garcia Plaza gives the last tactical orders to Joan Jordan (Alaves).
66' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
65' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
62' Ander Guevara (Alaves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Quintero had an easy-decision to make.
58' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) has a goal ruled out for offside!
55' One of the players from Alaves times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
54' Carlos Martin (Alaves) commits a rough foul. Alejandro Quintero stops the game and makes a call.
52' The manager makes a subsitution with Carlos Martin (Alaves) coming on for Abderrahmane Rebbach.
51' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Raul Albiol (Villarreal).
50' Villarreal have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
47' Villarreal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' Ilias Akhomach is being substituted because of an injury. Marcelino sends Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) on the pitch.
46' Referee Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+7' The end of the first half.
45+6' Alaves get a free kick.
45+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) was quite harsh and Alejandro Quintero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) will take the free kick.
43' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is able to continue to play.
42' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
42' The game is interrupted now, Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
40' A player from Alaves commits a rough challenge. Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
38' 1 - 0 Goal! Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) is teed up on the edge of the box by Nicolas Pepe, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom left corner gives the keeper no chance. 1:0.
38' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
34' Villarreal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
30' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle after Pape Gueye (Villarreal) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
24' Problems for Marcelino as Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Pau Navarro replaces him.
24' Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
23' Kike Garcia (Alaves) jumped for a header from a cross inside the 6-yard box, but the goalkeeper denies his effort as it bounces off his gloves and hits the post.
23' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Diego Conde is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
20' Ander Guevara (Alaves) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
17' The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
13' Alejandro Quintero blows the whistle, Jon Guridi (Alaves) is penalised for a foul.
12' Jon Guridi (Alaves) misses a great chance! He latches on to a fine cross into the box, but his effort misses the right post by a whisker.
11' Alex Baena (Villarreal) takes the corner kick, but Antonio Sivera reads it well and stops the effort.
10' Alex Baena (Villarreal) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
9' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) watches the corner all the way, but places his header a whisker wide of the left post from close range.
8' The ball goes out for a corner. Villarreal can continue in their attacking effort.
8' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play. Villarreal win a corner kick.
6' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
5' Alex Baena (Villarreal) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
4' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Alex Baena (Villarreal) takes it short.
4' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Villarreal will take a corner.
3' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
2' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Antonio Sivera, who smothers the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Villarreal will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Quintero was nominated as the referee for this game.
